text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan suffered an injury, so
we've come quickly to the infirmary.
Now, though, she's
hanging her head
dejectedly.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
No. I want to start doing recovery
exercises right
away.
choice_data_list: Machan, if you just get some rest,...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I've seen patients in physical therapy
before,
back at my mom's hospital. I saw
how hard they
all worked.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So I won't give up either. I'm prepared
for the
challenges ahead.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
choice_data_list: As long as it's within reason...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. Now that you mention it, my mom
used to
say the same thing to
overzealous patients.
choice_data_list: Doing rehab based on your own judg...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I messed up. I guess I got a little
overzealous
myself.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Very well. I'll start with a light workout
at the
gym.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's not too bad,
but it doesn't feel good.
I think it
might be time for a tactical
retreat.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I can't help but want to do something, though. I wonder if this is how my mom's patients felt...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the time being, Aston Machan steps
away
from training to focus on her
recovery.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
See? There's nothing a determined
mascot can't
do. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan takes charge of her
recovery and
returns to the track without
any setbacks.
